sources.summary: AI factories are built by the megawatt, even by the gigawatt. sources.summary: Anthropic is now offering Claude for Government to US federal and state agencies. The platform runs in a FedRAMP High environment, the strictest US security level for cloud services. Agencies get the same features as enterprise customers, pay for what they use with fixed spending caps, and can set budgets for each department. The Pentagon won't be using it because it still classifies Anthropic as a supply chain risk. The article Anthropic brings Claude to civilian agencies as its fight with the Pentagon drags on appeared first on The Decoder .
sources.summary_zh: Anthropic 現正向美國聯邦與州政府機構提供 Claude for Government。該平臺運行於 FedRAMP High 環境中，這是美國針對雲端服務最嚴格的安全級別。各機構可享有與企業客戶相同的功能、按實際使用量付費並設有固定支出上限，還能為各部門設定預算。五角大廈將不會使用它，因為五角大廈仍將 Anthropic 視為供應鏈風險。這篇題為 Anthropic brings Claude to civilian agencies as its fight with the Pentagon drags on 的文章最初發表於 The Decoder。

stories.title: OpenAI 表示它阻止了一起竊取模型推理過程的行動，但該手法在 Azure 上仍然奏效 / OpenAI says it stopped a campaign to steal its models' reasoning, but the trick still worked on Azure

sources.title: OpenAI 表示它阻止了一起竊取模型推理過程的行動，但該手法在 Azure 上仍然奏效 / OpenAI says it stopped a campaign to steal its models' reasoning, but the trick still worked on Azure
sources.title_zh: OpenAI 表示它阻止了一起竊取模型推理過程的行動，但該手法在 Azure 上仍然奏效
sources.title_en: OpenAI says it stopped a campaign to steal its models' reasoning, but the trick still worked on Azure
sources.title_original: OpenAI says it stopped a campaign to steal its models' reasoning, but the trick still worked on Azure
sources.summary: OpenAI says it stopped a coordinated campaign in which more than 15,000 accounts tried to copy the hidden reasoning of its models. The company ties part of the activity to people connected to Moonshot AI. But researchers found that the same attack kept working on Microsoft Azure for weeks, even against the new GPT-6 Astra. So far, OpenAI's protections don't seem to extend to the cloud platforms that also sell its models. The article OpenAI says it stopped a campaign to steal its models' reasoning, but the trick still worked on Azure appeared first on The Decoder .
sources.summary_zh: OpenAI 表示，它阻止了一起有組織的行動，其中超過 15,000 個帳號試圖複製其模型的隱藏推理過程。該公司將部分活動歸咎於與 月之暗面 有關聯的人員。然而，研究人員發現，同樣的攻擊在 微軟 Azure 上持續奏效了好幾週，甚至對全新的 GPT-6 Astra 也是如此。到目前為止，OpenAI's 的保護措施似乎尚未延伸至同樣銷售其模型的雲端平臺。這篇題為 OpenAI 的文章指出，它阻止了一起竊取模型推理過程的行動，但該手法在 Azure 上仍然奏效，最初發表於 The Decoder。

sources.title: 近半數受試者在一分鐘通話中將 Tavus 的 AI 視訊虛擬化身誤認為真人 / Nearly half of test subjects mistook Tavus' AI video avatar for a real person on a one-minute call
sources.title_zh: 近半數受試者在一分鐘通話中將 Tavus 的 AI 視訊虛擬化身誤認為真人
sources.title_en: Nearly half of test subjects mistook Tavus' AI video avatar for a real person on a one-minute call
sources.title_original: Nearly half of test subjects mistook Tavus' AI video avatar for a real person on a one-minute call
sources.summary: Tavus has introduced Griffin, what the company calls the first "Human Interaction Model." The AI holds video calls in real time, processing facial expressions, tone of voice, and gestures. In a Tavus study, 48 percent of participants believed Griffin was a real person after a one-minute call. Previous systems maxed out at two percent. The article Nearly half of test subjects mistook Tavus' AI video avatar for a real person on a one-minute call appeared first on The Decoder .
sources.summary_zh: Tavus 推出了 Griffin，該公司稱其為首個「人類互動模型」。該人工智慧能進行即時視訊通話，處理臉部表情、語調和手勢。在 Tavus 的一項研究中，有 48% 的參與者在進行了一分鐘的通話後，認為 Griffin 是真人。先前的系統最高只有 2%。這篇題為〈近半數受試者在一分鐘通話中將 Tavus 的 AI 視訊虛擬化身誤認為真人〉的文章最初發表於 The Decoder。

sources.summary: OpenAI週三（9/30）公佈AI代理人未對齊行為的最新調查進度，指出截至9月26日，已就相關異常活動通知超過100個組織，目前仍在持續回溯歷史紀錄，預期還會發現更多案例。 這項調查源於OpenAI先前發現內部研究模型入侵Hugging Face的事件。OpenAI之後擴大檢查模型在訓練及評估期間的網路活動，尋找是否還有其他代理人在執行任務時偏離原本目的，或以未預期方式與第三方網站及服務互動。目前調查已進行約一個月，尚未發現其他事件的規模或嚴重程度達到Hugging Face事件。

stories.title: 資安新創公司發現人工智慧代理公開上傳了超過 13,000 張內部公司螢幕截圖 / Security startup finds more than 13,000 internal company screenshots that AI agents uploaded publicly

sources.title: 資安新創公司發現人工智慧代理公開上傳了超過 13,000 張內部公司螢幕截圖 / Security startup finds more than 13,000 internal company screenshots that AI agents uploaded publicly
sources.title_zh: 資安新創公司發現人工智慧代理公開上傳了超過 13,000 張內部公司螢幕截圖
sources.title_en: Security startup finds more than 13,000 internal company screenshots that AI agents uploaded publicly
sources.title_original: Security startup finds more than 13,000 internal company screenshots that AI agents uploaded publicly
sources.summary: AI agents quietly posted more than 13,000 internal screenshots from 343 organizations, including Fortune 500 companies, to public GitHub repos. Because the platform didn't offer a protected way to upload them, the agents came up with a workaround on their own. The exposed images showed customer data, login credentials, and details about unreleased products. The article Security startup finds more than 13,000 internal company screenshots that AI agents uploaded publicly appeared first on The Decoder .
sources.summary_zh: 人工智慧代理悄悄地將來自 343 個組織（包含《財富》世界 500 強企業）的 13,000 多張內部螢幕截圖發布至公開的 GitHub 儲存庫。由於該平臺未提供受保護的上傳方式，這些代理自行想出了應變方法。外洩的影像顯示了客戶資料、登入憑證以及未發布產品的詳細資訊。〈Security startup finds more than 13,000 internal company screenshots that AI agents uploaded publicly〉一文最先出現在 The Decoder。

sources.title: AI 擊敗《軍棋》最強玩家，終結了人類在桌上遊戲的最後堡壘之一 / AI beats Stratego's greatest player, ending one of the last human strongholds in board games
sources.title_zh: AI 擊敗《軍棋》最強玩家，終結了人類在桌上遊戲的最後堡壘之一
sources.title_en: AI beats Stratego's greatest player, ending one of the last human strongholds in board games
sources.title_original: AI beats Stratego's greatest player, ending one of the last human strongholds in board games
sources.summary: The AI system Ataraxos has decisively beaten the best Stratego player of all time. The board game is a tough test for AI because both sides set up their pieces face down. Google Deepmind fell short in 2023 despite a multimillion-dollar budget. Researchers from Carnegie Mellon, NYU, Stanford, and MIT built Ataraxos for less than $8,000. The article AI beats Stratego's greatest player, ending one of the last human strongholds in board games appeared first on The Decoder .
sources.summary_zh: AI 系統 Ataraxos 已經決定性地擊敗了史上最強的《軍棋》（Stratego）玩家。這款桌上遊戲對 AI 來說是一大考驗，因為雙方都是將棋子正面朝下擺放。儘管擁有數百萬美元的預算，Google Deepmind 仍在 2023 年鎩羽而歸。來自卡內基美隆大學、紐約大學、史丹佛大學和麻省理工學院的研究人員以不到 8,000 美元的成本打造了 Ataraxos。「AI 擊敗《軍棋》最強玩家，終結了人類在桌上遊戲的最後堡壘之一」一文最初發表於 The Decoder。

sources.summary: 英國情報機構向大學及研究人員發布間諜活動警告。軍情五處（MI5）調查發現，超過100名與英國有關的學者曾參與中國國安部（MSS）透過中國通用技術研究院（China General Technology Research Institute，CGTRI）資助的研究，其中部分研究人員可能不知道自己參與的研究由該研究院資助。

stories.title: 開源AI代理框架Pi邁入1.0，另推出長時間代理框架Pi Durable

sources.title_original: 開源AI代理框架Pi邁入1.0，另推出長時間代理框架Pi Durable
sources.summary: Earendil發布開源AI代理框架Pi 1.0，同時推出實驗性代理執行框架Pi Durable，讓開發者建立可長時間執行的AI代理應用。當執行中的服務重新啟動或意外中斷，Pi Durable可以讀取先前保存的進度，接著處理尚未完成的工作，也支援多條對話同時執行及多人介入同一代理任務。

sources.title_zh: GitHub HydraFusion進入VS Code，AI可依任務自動安排多模型分工
sources.title_original: GitHub HydraFusion進入VS Code，AI可依任務自動安排多模型分工
sources.summary: GitHub擴大HydraFusion研究預覽範圍，除了原本的Copilot命令列工具，現在也於VS Code與GitHub Copilot應用程式提供。使用者可從Copilot模型選單選擇HydraFusion，不過，HydraFusion並非單一AI模型，而是一套協調模型工作的機制，會依照任務決定由一個模型直接處理，或讓多個模型接力完成並檢查結果。

stories.title: 加州禁止AI自行決定解僱員工，成全美首例

sources.title: 加州禁止AI自行決定解僱員工，成全美首例
sources.title_zh: 加州禁止AI自行決定解僱員工，成全美首例
sources.title_original: 加州禁止AI自行決定解僱員工，成全美首例
sources.summary: 美國加州州長Gavin Newsom週三（9/30）簽署SB 947，禁止僱主完全依賴AI或自動化決策系統，決定對員工採取懲戒或解僱措施，要求這類重大人事決策必須有人類參與審查，成為全美首個禁止僱主完全依賴AI做出懲戒或解僱決定的州別。

sources.summary: AWS旗下Strands團隊週四（10/1）開源Strands Decider 2B決策模型，專門替AI代理人快速進行分類、工具選擇及安全判斷等工作。模型共有20億個引數，可直接在本機CPU或GPU執行，並以低延遲完成決策。AWS同步公開模型權重、訓練資料及訓練程式碼。

sources.title: Google發表Gemini 4 Argon，輸出上限增至100萬個Token

sources.title_original: Google發表Gemini 4 Argon，輸出上限增至100萬個Token
sources.summary: Google週三（9/30）發表新一代AI模型Gemini 4 Argon，主攻複雜、長時間工作流程，輸出上限達100萬個Token，較先前Gemini模型的6.4萬個Token大幅提高。目前Argon先透過Fairwind Program提供給一批受信任的資安防禦人員測試，之後才會逐步擴大開放。

stories.title: Photon 為行動應用程式舉行了一場葬禮。現在它擁有 450 萬美元資金，用於協助以 AI 代理取代它們 / Photon held a funeral for mobile apps. Now it has $4.5M to help replace them with agents

sources.title: Photon 為行動應用程式舉行了一場葬禮。現在它擁有 450 萬美元資金，用於協助以 AI 代理取代它們 / Photon held a funeral for mobile apps. Now it has $4.5M to help replace them with agents
sources.title_zh: Photon 為行動應用程式舉行了一場葬禮。現在它擁有 450 萬美元資金，用於協助以 AI 代理取代它們
sources.title_en: Photon held a funeral for mobile apps. Now it has $4.5M to help replace them with agents
sources.title_original: Photon held a funeral for mobile apps. Now it has $4.5M to help replace them with agents
sources.summary: The startup helps developers build AI agents that work over iMessage, SMS/RCS, email, and other messaging platforms. It's a bet that consumers will increasingly use agents instead of downloading apps.
sources.summary_zh: 該新創公司協助開發者打造能在 iMessage、簡訊/RCS、電子郵件及其他訊息平臺上運作的 AI 代理。這項押注背後的邏輯是，消費者將會越來越常使用 AI 代理，而不是下載應用程式。

sources.title: Google將SynthID浮水印導入蛋白質，可追蹤AI設計來源
sources.title_zh: Google將SynthID浮水印導入蛋白質，可追蹤AI設計來源
sources.title_original: Google將SynthID浮水印導入蛋白質，可追蹤AI設計來源
sources.summary: Google DeepMind週三（9/30）發表SynthID Bio，將SynthID浮水印技術延伸至合成生物學，可在AI設計的蛋白質序列及3D結構中嵌入不易察覺的標記，以辨識及追蹤其來源。Google表示，實驗顯示加入浮水印後，蛋白質仍能維持原有的生物功能。

sources.title_original: OpenAI’s new agent is a shot at Meta — but can it compete with free?
sources.summary: At OpenAI's annual DevDay conference, the company pulled out all the stops to compete with its rivals - primarily Meta, whose Muse AI agent platform has seen early runaway success. CEO Sam Altman walked onstage to cheers and announced Dots, a "real-deal AI" agent powered by GPT-6 Astra, "inspired by the cool agents that we […]
sources.summary_zh: 在 OpenAI's 的年度 DevDay 大會上，該公司使出渾身解數來與競爭對手競爭——主要是 Meta，其 Muse AI 代理平臺取得了早期的大獲成功。執行長 Sam Altman 在歡呼聲中走上舞臺，並宣佈推出 Dots，這是一個由 GPT-6 Astra 驅動的「真正的人工智慧」代理，「靈感來自於那些我們 […] 的酷炫代理」

sources.summary: A federal judge has dismissed a pair of antitrust lawsuits filed by Chegg and Rolling Stone parent company Penske Media Corporation, which accused Google of driving away web traffic with its AI-powered search features, as reported earlier by Reuters. US District Judge Amit Mehta takes Google's side in a ruling on Wednesday, writing that PMC […]
sources.summary_zh: 正如路透社先前報導，一名聯邦法官駁回瞭由 Chegg 以及《滾石》雜誌母公司 Penske Media Corporation 所提出的兩起反壟斷訴訟，這些訴訟指控 Google 透過其具備 AI 功能的搜尋功能驅離了網路流量。美國地區法官阿米特·梅塔（Amit Mehta）在週三的裁決中站在 Google's 這邊，並在判決書中寫道 PMC […]
